steps.content: By the stars I walk; ghosts wail, gods tremble! All foul spirits, seized and delivered to justice—
A rush of flame licks past you, drawing a line of fire that sends the phantoms reeling backward.
Amid the crackling heat, there's a brittle snap at your back, like dead wood splitting.
You spin around and find yourself staring at a familiar face, one that doesn't look quite as you remember.
[Chengxiao portrait]
He still bears Chengxiao's form, but a hard mask now covers his eyes, and dark fissures coil up his arms, cinching the fabric of his sleeves. The fate waiting for him speaks for itself.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: What is it? You think I'm one of them?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How did you get down here? I thought Lichen had the coin.
He lifts an arm and offers you a full view of his form. Unlike Lichen, the figure before you is something nearer to a half-seen silhouette.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: I was able to assist you before because I had sealed my soul within the coin. But Li Xianling shattered it. My soul escaped and became trapped here in the Void of Yin.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So that's what you left behind. Without your soul, of course you can't leave.
A nod. His tone remains light, almost dismissively so.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: On the bright side, I can now be of proper use to you down here.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: I am well aware of what Li Xianling said about my coin. That it could only flip up or down, that a single swat from a monster sent it flying, that it was nothing compared to her spells.
Those last words were yours, actually. But you have no intention of owning up to that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I've seen it for myself now. You're the stronger one, clearly.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Telling people exactly what they want to hear... did you pick that up from her as well? She and her silver tongue... Do not let her be a bad influence.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: To be fair, her spells are still stronger. She'll use just about anything.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: That one, forever resorting to unorthodox methods, burning through her own spells in the process. Do not let her be a bad influence.
Your gaze falls. That vision of her blood-soaked hand cuts through your thoughts again, and your chest tightens in response.

steps.speaker: Phantom
steps.content: Hsss... Haaa...
Not far off, the phantoms Chengxiao struck back are writhing, their form slowly knitting back into clarity. The broken limbs littering the ground have begun to squirm, crawling toward the torsos.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Watch out, they are getting back up.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: No need for concern.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: These souls are still quite weak. So long as we refrain from disrupting their ritual, they will not attack.
It's not like you wanted to disturb them. You just had nowhere else to go.
The grumble is still settling in your chest when his lips curve upward, and he throws a question back at you.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Have you not already conducted the experiment yourself?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Conducted the experiment? I've been running for my life down here.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: This is part of the experiment.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You... you've been tagging along as a coin this whole time, and all the while I was your test subject? Some professor you are...
Your accusation lands, but he takes it without a trace of guilt.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: "Test subject" is not a derogatory term. A pity we are in a place like this, or the work might have earned you some extra school credit.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Besides, I was watching over you the entire way. And you came out just fine, did you not?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I've heard that line from Lichen too. Birds of a feather, I guess...
His reassurance doesn't land. A phantom up ahead suddenly raises its head, and your muscles jerk, ready to flee, before you even decide to move.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Stand still.
A steady hand clamps onto your shoulder and keeps you rooted where you stand. Only then do you sense it: something thick and frigid gliding just past your heel.
Seconds drag by before the presence retreats into the distance. You lift your gaze and find Chengxiao's masked face above you, the corner of his mouth tilted faintly upward.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: I am watching.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Right.

Your fingers gradually uncurl, and you track the phantom as it moves into the distance. Its drifting motion mirrors the cyan fish exactly. Then again, why wouldn't it? They have always been the same thing.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: These phantoms... they're all turned from those spirit fish, the ones Lichen was controlling.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: They appear to be the wishes of the people, gathered and shaped by Li Xianling. When many pray in the Realm of Yang, these wishes take form here in the Void of Yin. The stronger their faith, the more human these things become.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: In turn, they repeat their rituals of worship here, over and over. Whether this is mere mimicry of the living, or whether some other purpose drives it... I have only speculation to offer at present.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: I cannot draw any conclusions without further study.
He looks at you while he says it, then lets his eyes drift back toward the contorted cyan figures in the distance.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: But if you wish to try...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't.
You shut it down immediately. Chengxiao must have seen it coming, because the moment the words leave your mouth, a laugh slips out from him.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Honestly, I kind of wish you'd just read the fortune like a proper Daoist priest right now...

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: I already did. The divination says one thing only: engage them in prolonged combat, and death is certain.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Yeah, I figured that part out.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Which is precisely why knowing what will happen is not enough. One must understand why.

The phantoms he'd mentioned as subjects for study keep murmuring their ceaseless prayers, bowing their heads to the empty air. With each bow, the color of their forms becomes a little brighter than before.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: It seems Li Xianling is conducting something of an experiment herself... She has finally learned to pursue knowledge through proper methods. A pity she has applied them in entirely the wrong place.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Their appearance is growing increasingly aberrant. If they continue this ritual unchecked, the consequences may well defy imagination.
Chengxiao sighs.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Though I must admit... I bear some small responsibility for what has come to pass.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your responsibility...?

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Which is why I had to come and see for myself what she was truly after.
He seems intent on avoiding a direct reply. You tighten your lips and decide not to push further.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Alright. And we need to find a way to get your soul back, too.
He smiles and gives a nod.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Then I shall be counting on you.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Naturally, she had no intention of letting me spoil her plans. She summoned a number of souls to waylay me and used the opportunity to slip away.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know how to find her.
—<color=#fb9259>Shackles</color>.
You extend your hand, and a subtle pulse stirs at the center of your palm, threading outward into the deeper dark. You let it guide you, stepping forward into the unknown.
